response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_group_bandusagepct, AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_group_telescope_count FROM (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) AS grouped;
